summary: v6_rps_001 Steen-Papier-Schaar mini-game: backend (11/11 pytest) + frontend (modal+flow) fully verified. All chat triggers (open/stats/reset), game flow (start/play x12/reset/stop), stats, cards endpoint, learning flag, achievements, XP delta and UI score-updates work correctly. Reset clears session without touching lifetime stats. Close button closes modal.

issues: KB-card images (steen/papier/schaar) are ~3 MB each at 1254x1254 — the choice tiles render blank/empty for ~1.5-2.5s on a fresh open. Consider a thumbnail variant served via /api/system-archive/file/{id}?w=160 or similar to make first-paint snappy. Functionally correct, just slow first impression.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add thumbnail/resize support for the RPS KB-card images so the choice tiles paint instantly instead of after ~2s load.
critical_code_review_comments: rps_service.play_round: small race-condition possible — if user clicks reset while a play() in flight, the play's setSession() may overwrite the reset state. In practice ~800ms setTimeout + disabled buttons during 'thinking' mitigate this, but technically the resetScore() can be hit via keyboard / other flows. Optional: cancel pending in-flight play on reset.
RpsBark.js click outside backdrop calls stopGame which also POSTs /games/rps/stop. This is desired per spec but worth noting that an accidental misclick on backdrop ends the session.
Backend rps_routes.RPS_CARDS hardcodes KB IDs and file IDs — fine for MVP, but if the KB items are ever recreated those IDs drift. Consider resolving lazily from the KB by stable key.

rca of the issue: No bugs. All requested feature behavior matches spec. Only observation: 3 MB choice-card images cause a brief first-paint delay (cosmetic).
